title: AI Agents in M365
subtitle: Making AI agents easy to find, simple to create, and trusted collaborators.
thumbnailDescription: Making AI agents easy to find, simple to create, and trusted collaborators.

sections.heading: Challenge
sections.overviewBody: I worked on shaping how AI agents become part of everyday work, designing holistic experiences that let people discover the right agent, create their own, and collaborate with agents as trusted teammates. Focused on interaction design, system thinking, and trust-building for AI, ensuring these experiences feel seamless, useful, and human-centered. My impact is measured in 3 stages:

items.title: Discovery
items.description: Helping users explore, find and acquire agents in context through smart recommendations and a curated Agent Store.

items.title: Creation
items.description: Making agent creation approachable with template-first flows, vibe coding-style and a simplified builder experience.

items.title: Collaboration
items.description: Giving users visibility and control of Agent capabilities that transforms how they collaborate with agents, unlocking new ways to get work done.

sections.heading: The designs
sections.description:
Due to confidentiality, I can only share a limited view of the project. Here are a few examples of the flows and designs our team created.
I’d be happy to walk you through the details and answer any questions during a call.

flows.title: Agent Discovery
flows.description: Users were overwhelmed by a growing catalog of agents and unsure which one fit their task. Discovery needed to feel contextual, trustworthy, and lightweight.
whatIDid: Designed in-chat recommendations for just-in-time discovery.
Created all-new Agent Store, entry points and added trust signals.

cards.title: Response confidence levels
cards.description: As the LLM presents recommendations based on user context, different UI is presented to highlight a high-confidence recommendation or be less loud if the confidence level is low.

flows.title: Agent Creation
flows.description: Agent Builder had high drop-off rates; users felt intimidated by a blank canvas. Needed a guided, approachable flow that scales from simple templates to advanced customization.
whatIDid: Introduced template-first flow for quick starts.
impact: Improved completion rates in internal tests.

flows.title: Agent Collaboration
flows.description: Agents worked invisibly across apps; users lacked oversight and trust. Needed a way to see, steer, and audit agent actions across multiple surfaces.
whatIDid: Concepted Agent overview for cross-surface activity.
Defined task delegation flows for Agents in multiple canvases.
impact: Contributed to guidance for assistive agents.

items.title: Higher engagement
bullets: Increased number of agents created per active user.

items.title: Lower drop-off
bullets: Reduced drop-off from Store browse to agent activation.
Significant reduction in abandonment during Builder flow after template-first design.

items.title: Scale discovery
items.description: Explore personalization for agent recommendations and richer context cues to improve trust and relevance.

items.title: Deepen collaboration
items.description: Expand Agent reach with proactive insights and multi-agent coordination.

items.title: Measure and iterate
items.description: Continue tracking engagement, completion rates, and sentiment to refine flows and validate design principles.

cards.title: Discovery is powered by trust
cards.description: Users ignore catalogs; they respond to timely, explainable suggestions. Context beats quantity.

cards.title: Creating is a confidence curve
cards.description: Start simple, then progressively reveal power. Blank canvases kill momentum.

cards.title: Collaboration needs visibility
cards.description: AI “coworkers” succeed only when users can see what’s happening and intervene easily.

cards.title: System thinking beats isolated screens
cards.description: Designing for AI means orchestrating flows across the system, not just polishing one UI.
